structure.text: Two panes side by side: the list on the left stays visible, the chosen event's detail on the right.

row.text: The calibrated probability, the basis (gap to the traditional market) and the trust score.

sort.text: Largest edge first: the biggest gap between the calibrated probability and the price, weighted by trust.

controls.text: One search box that also understands words like "macro" or "trusted" (no separate filter).

money.text: Top right of the header, two numbers (the sketch).

detailOrder.text: The probability first: calibrated vs price vs the traditional market, then the trade, then the allocation.

kelly.text: One dollar figure and one line of why (probability vs price).

nav.text: Two text links in the header next to the product name.
